money_section.confidence_note: This early in the season the model runs a little confident: it takes today's projections and rosters as right, so the favourites' odds are likely a few points high.
money_section.totals_note: Season totals hold every roster as it stands apart from the moves the league's rules force (IL stints and the replacement-level fill-ins they open), and they run low by design.
lines: Nothing is settled: every manager can still finish anywhere from -$135 to +$270 across the regular-season pot and the playoff pot.

The likeliest +$135 finish is Hayden's (18.8%): he wins the regular-season pot ($180, from 3rd and 4th) and loses his playoff semifinal ($45 into the playoff pot). The same finish for the others: Nick 13.2%, Garrett 2.9%, Benton 2.2%.

Regular-season title odds: Nick about 55%, Hayden about 30%, Garrett about 8%, Benton about 6%. This early in the season the model runs a little confident: it takes today's projections and rosters as right, so the favourites' odds are likely a few points high.
Expected net dollars across both pots, an average over the simulated seasons rather than a forecast of any one: Nick +$113, Hayden +$11, Garrett -$58, Benton -$66.

Projected regular-season points: Nick 25,006, Hayden 24,226, Garrett 23,528, Benton 23,346. Season totals hold every roster as it stands apart from the moves the league's rules force (IL stints and the replacement-level fill-ins they open), and they run low by design.
The Cup carries no cash; its winner keeps a sixth player in 2027-28. Chance of that sixth keeper, never added to the dollars: Nick 35.6%, Hayden 32.6%, Garrett 21.9%, Benton 10.0%.
